description:
**Practice Consultant (Sustainability, Digital & AI)**

**New Delhi**

  
  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  
  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

You’ll join Bain’s Sustainability Practice, which helps our clients make critical decisions at the core of their business strategy. Our work spans sustainability strategy, the environmental and social impact of operations, stakeholder engagement, and sustainability-related growth and cost opportunities.

We help ensure sustainability efforts are grounded in business fundamentals, demonstrate a clear return on investment, and become firmly embedded within our clients’ strategies and operations.

As part of the Sustainability Practice, you’ll collaborate globally with colleagues across Bain, including client-facing teams and digital and technical specialists, to develop innovative perspectives, products, and solutions that help our clients achieve results.

  
  

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

As a Practice Consultant focused on Sustainability, Digital & AI, you’ll be a critical member of our Sustainability Practice. From day one, you’ll bring analytical, interpersonal, creative thinking, business management, and leadership skills to help advance the practice’s annual and longer-term goals.

You’ll support case teams in delivering results for clients, help build new intellectual property and solutions, and contribute to global collaboration and our external visibility and differentiation.

A key part of your role will be exploring how AI, digital tools, automation, and emerging technologies can strengthen our sustainability solutions. You’ll work with technical specialists and practice colleagues to translate sustainability hypotheses and business needs into practical tools and prototypes.

  
  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

Solution design, development, deployment, and delivery

* Own and maintain the Sustainability Practice’s intellectual property and solution backlog, supporting competitive research, gap identification, and research into ecosystem offerings, partners, and emerging AI and digital tools.

* Conduct analysis and support business case development for solution investments.

* Develop intellectual property, including global reports, research briefs, market overviews, and solution- and topic-specific materials tailored to sectors and industries.

* Identify issues, develop hypotheses, execute analyses, translate data into meaningful insights, and present recommendations to key decision-makers.

* Support the day-to-day implementation of transformation projects, with a focus on delivering and operationalizing strategic initiatives that create meaningful business outcomes and impact.

* Provide hands-on support to clients and case teams in leveraging technology and AI solutions.

* Lead or contribute to the design and prototyping of AI-enabled tools and minimum viable products, working with technical specialists and our Production Engineering team to translate sustainability hypotheses into working prototypes that can be piloted with case teams and clients.

* Develop training materials that help colleagues use the latest intellectual property, AI capabilities, and digital tools.

* Surface new ideas, share learnings from pilots, and champion emerging technologies across the practice.

* Monitor developments in AI and emerging technologies and translate them into practical insights, tools, and training opportunities for colleagues.

* Identify opportunities to embed automation, analytics, and emerging technologies into our work to enhance delivery and impact.

Practice strategy, planning, and reporting

* Support win/loss learning and feedback loops for Sustainability Practice pitches and proposals, incorporating insights into our competitive knowledge base.

* Support planning for the commercialization of intellectual property and solutions, including developing investment business cases, ROI models, impact assessments, and commercialization plans.

* Support the development of sustainability diagnostic tools and frameworks, as applicable.

* Provide direct support for proposals.

* Support the collection, maintenance, and analysis of data relating to experts and commercial materials.

Practice communications and teaming

* Work effectively across practices and functions, proactively sharing and seeking information while focusing on the implications that matter most.

* Serve as a bridge between the Sustainability Practice and digital and technical teams, helping ensure AI-driven solutions align with business and sustainability impact goals.

* Support impact tracking and feedback loops for piloted tools and intellectual property to inform iteration and broader scaling.

* Train and informally coach junior team members, as appropriate.

  
  

**ABOUT YOU**

You bring:

* 5–8 years of top-tier management consulting experience, or equivalent experience such as product management or strategy roles at a technology firm, plus an undergraduate degree; or 4–5 years of relevant experience with an MBA or master’s degree.

* Experience, expertise, or a strong interest in sustainability, including applying AI and digital technologies to sustainability solutions.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear insights and recommendations.

* The ability to drive a piece of work end-to-end with limited direction and perform complex, accurate analysis.

* A continuous-learning mindset and the ability to translate experience into thoughtful recommendations for improvement.

* Strong communication skills, including the ability to structure impactful presentations and updates and clearly communicate insights and implications.

* The ability to lead effective small meetings and contribute confidently in discussions with senior stakeholders.

* A track record of inspiring, motivating, and developing junior team members.

* A passion for sustainability and for deploying innovative techniques and tools that help clients accelerate growth and reach their full potential.

* Deep familiarity with AI and machine-learning technologies and tools, such as Python, R, and OpenAI APIs, and an applied understanding of how they can create business value.

* Comfort using AI technologies and tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok, with an applied understanding of how they can create business value.

* Demonstrated product thinking, with the ability to translate product hypotheses and user needs into focused, testable prototypes; rapidly execute them using AI solutions; inform feature prioritization; and guide digital solution development in partnership with technical and practice teams.

* The ability to communicate technical and digital concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

* The ability to design, build, and deploy AI-enabled minimum viable products, connecting large language model and third-party APIs into working application flows.

* Hands-on experience prototyping with modern data and AI tools, such as Replit, V0, Codex, Claude Code, SQL, retrieval-augmented generation, or large language model-based workflows, without requiring production-engineering depth.

* An interest in the technology industry, including digital transformation and disruptive business models.

* Fluency in English.

Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams—including engineers, product managers, and sustainability experts—is beneficial. Experience in fast-evolving, ambiguous environments such as internal innovation teams or digital incubators, as well as familiarity with machine-learning workflows such as model training, evaluation, or deployment, would also be valuable.

You’ll need flexibility in your working hours to collaborate with our global team and will follow local office and Product, Practice & Knowledge in-office guidelines.

description:
**JOB ROLE : SENIOR MANAGER, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING**

Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)  
Department: Product Development

**ABOUT GHX**

GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) is a leading healthcare technology company on a mission to simplify the business of healthcare and improve patient outcomes. Founded in 2000, GHX has built the world's largest cloud-based supply chain community connecting healthcare providers, suppliers, distributors, and partners to automate processes, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency. GHX continues to innovate with intelligent automation and AI-driven capabilities across its product portfolio.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

GHX is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a multi-disciplinary engineering team that powers intelligent, AI-augmented automation across multiple product lines with document understanding — extracting structured meaning from unstructured documents and data — as one of its core technical problems. This team spans three areas: a platform engineering team (AI, DevOps, Infra, architecture, business continuity, security etc.), a set of product-line delivery teams (each building product-specific business logic, validation, and integrations), and a team building the Human-in-the-Loop (HiTL) application along with reporting/analytics capabilities.

You will lead through team leads or senior engineers rather than running delivery for a single team directly. You will set technical direction for shared platform capabilities that every product-line team depends on, while ensuring each product line independently meets its own functionality, quality, and delivery commitments. You will work directly with business, product, and operations stakeholders across every product line this platform serves, and you will own end-to-end outcomes: people, technical direction, and customer impact across the full teams.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Organizational & Engineering Leadership:**

* Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary team spanning platform engineering, product-line delivery teams, and HiTL/analytics, working through team leads and senior engineers rather than direct, single-team execution.

* Set technical direction for shared platform capabilities (AI/agents, infra, security, cost optimization, eval pipelines) that multiple product-line teams depend on.

* Build and grow leads and senior engineers within each team, developing the next layer of technical leadership, not just individual contributors.

* Own the vendor relationship for external development partners: define interface contracts, hold delivery leads accountable across teams, and resolve cross-team dependencies.

* Establish org-wide engineering culture, standards, and practices that scale consistently across all three streams.

**Technical Direction & Architecture:**

* Guide architectural and design decisions across product-line teams to ensure consistency, reuse, and alignment with the shared platform.

* Resolve cross-team technical trade-offs — for example, shared platform constraints versus a product line's specific needs.

* Engage hands-on selectively, on foundational platform decisions or critical blockers

* Champion AI-augmented engineering practices (AI-assisted code generation, review, test automation) across all teams, ensuring adoption and responsible use of AI/LLM tooling with appropriate evaluation, monitoring, and human-in-the-loop controls.

**Stakeholder & Delivery Management:**

* Interface directly with business, product, operations and support stakeholders for each product line to align priorities, resolve conflicts, and ensure each line's functionality, quality, and timelines are independently met.

* Balance platform-level priorities, which are shared across all product lines, against individual product-line delivery commitments.

* Communicate delivery status, risk, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders at all levels, from individual product owners to senior leadership.

* Own the release process across teams: coordinate QA, product, and stakeholders to ship reliably across multiple concurrent product-line commitments.

**Operational Excellence:**

* Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability standards that scale across the platform and all product-line teams.

* Ensure robust testing practices (unit, component, integration) are a baseline across every team, not an afterthought.

* Champion CI/CD adoption and optimization across the team.

* Coordinate incident response and on-call coverage across the platform and product-line services.

* Collaborate with the Security team to resolve findings and complete compliance reviews across all teams in a timely manner.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Experience:**

* 15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years managing engineering managers, team leads, or senior tech leads — not only individual contributors.

* Demonstrated experience running two-three teams with a shared platform layer and independent delivery teams or pods.

* Proven track record of building and scaling engineering leadership — developing leads and senior engineers, not just growing headcount.

* Experience owning delivery against firm deadlines with external dependencies (vendor teams, APIs, platform dependencies) across multiple concurrent workstreams.

* Strong background in cloud-native, microservices-based architecture on AWS or Azure.

* Experience building document understanding or intelligent document processing systems — classification, extraction, OCR/layout analysis, or structured-data-from-unstructured-input pipelines — at production scale.

* Solid experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into production software — LLM-based pipelines, agentic workflows, or setting up eval pipelines — at a platform level serving multiple consuming teams.

**Technical Breadth:**

* Backend development: Python/Java, FastAPI.

* Frontend familiarity: Angular/React, JavaScript or TypeScript — enough to review and guide UI engineers.

* Cloud platforms: AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, S3, SQS, ECS/EKS, API Gateway) or equivalent Azure services.

* Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, or other relational/NoSQL stores.

* CI/CD and infrastructure: GitHub Actions, Bamboo, Terraform, Docker, or similar.

* LLM tooling and frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, Pydantic, or equivalent orchestration

* Observability: structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting — Datadog, LangSmith, or equivalent.

* Testing: Selenium, Playwright, Postman, or similar automation tools.

* AI-powered development tools: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree is a plus but not required.

  

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

* Sets technical direction where a clear answer doesn't yet exist — comfortable operating in undefined problem spaces (agentic architecture, cost/latency trade-offs, evaluation methodology).

* Leads through leads: develops the layer of technical leadership beneath them rather than relying solely on personal technical authority.

* Represents the team to multiple business/product stakeholders simultaneously, each with independent and sometimes competing priorities.

* Strong communicator across all levels — explains technical trade-offs to engineers and leads, and business risk and roadmap impact to senior stakeholders, with equal clarity.

* Strategic thinker who keeps multi-quarter, cross-team outcomes in focus without losing sight of individual product-line delivery commitments.

* Decisive under ambiguity — gathers the right inputs across teams, makes the call, and owns the outcome.

* High emotional maturity: handles delivery pressure, stakeholder conflict, and cross-team trade-offs with composure and directness.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 6 MONTHS**

* You have built trust with team leads and engineers across all three teams and understand the platform and product-line systems deeply enough to make sound cross-team technical decisions.

* Delivery is predictable across every product line — stakeholders are not surprised by slippage, and each team ships on its committed roadmap.

* The shared platform (AI/agents, infra, eval pipelines, cost optimization) is visibly maturing and reducing duplicated effort across product-line teams.

* You have a clear view of vendor performance and stakeholder relationships across every product line the team serves.

**GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare**  
Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.

GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.

It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. title: Senior Associate - AI Engineer (PEG Alpha)
description:
**About us**

Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

**Who you will work with**

BCN Private Equity Group CoE at Bain & Company provides specialized support to global teams across the private equity value chain, enabling clients to make key investment decisions. Our expertise lies in addressing critical diligence questions through a range of products such as survey analytics, digital diagnostic, workforce analytics and disruption assessment. Our teams work in a fast-paced environment delivering consistent and impactful results at scale. In the last decade, we have witnessed an exponential growth, reaching >250 members today from ~10 members in 2013. We operate from 3 locations – 2 in India and 1 in Poland, and operate across all 3 regions (EMEA, Americas and APAC). BCN PEG provides an opportunity to solve challenging business problems in a dynamic set-up working closely with global Bain teams, acting as a thought-partner with daily deliverables.

**What you’ll do**

We are looking for a talented and driven Senior Associate – BCN PEG Americas - Alpha Agentic Factory to join the Bain Capability Network. You will own AI products end to end, from technical scoping through production, building the next generation of AI-powered products and intelligent workflows that transform how Bain's global consulting teams work.

This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge AI development and full stack engineering. You will work alongside senior engineers, data scientists, and consulting teams to rapidly prototype and scale AI solutions — from LLM-powered applications to agentic systems — in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

* Build and integrate LLM-powered features: RAG pipelines, AI agents, and intelligent workflows
* Develop GenAI capabilities including prompt engineering, embeddings, memory systems, and evaluation
* Implement backend services in Python (FastAPI) to support AI applications
* Develop responsive, high-quality frontend interfaces using React and TypeScript
* Collaborate on designing multi-agent architecture and orchestration systems

* Build and maintain scalable APIs and microservices to power AI applications
* Ensure production-quality, well-tested, maintainable code across the stack
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and cloud deployments
* Rapidly prototype AI-powered tools and MVPs to validate ideas with consulting teams
* Iterate quickly on feedback and help scale successful prototypes to production
* Experiment with emerging AI frameworks, models, and techniques
* Own AI products end to end, from technical scoping and architecture through build, launch, adoption, and iteration
* Engineering support for pilot AI tools on cases requirements, solution options, effort estimates, and delivery plans
* Partner with senior engineers and architects to align technical directions
* Participate in agile delivery cycles, sprint planning, and technical reviews

**About you:**

Experience

* 4-6 years of experience in full stack software engineering, including 1-2+ years building and shipping LLM/GenAI applications
* Hands-on experience building and shipping production-grade web applications end-to-end
* Experience owning a product or major feature, including technical scoping, estimation, and delivery with non-technical stakeholders
* Proven track record of working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments — startups, consulting, or innovation teams preferred
* Exposure to private equity, management consulting, or data-driven business environments is a plus

Technical Skills — Required

* Python (FastAPI / Flask), React & TypeScript, GenAI / LLM Ecosystems, RAG Pipelines & Agents, Vector DBs & Embeddings, REST APIs & Microservices, SQL / NoSQL Databases, Git & Modern Dev Workflows, Docker & CI/CD Basics

Technical Skills — Preferred

* Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP
* LLMOps, evaluation frameworks, and AI observability tooling
* Multi-agent systems and AI orchestration frameworks (e.g. Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen)
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code)
* Familiarity with Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code
* Familiarity with agent development patterns, such as agent harnesses and skill and tool design, using managed agent platforms or frameworks (e.g. Claude Managed Agents, Claude Agent SDK, LangChain)

Soft Skills & Mindset

* Strong ownership mentality — you ship things and take pride in quality
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and translating loosely defined problems into working solutions
* Collaborative team player who communicates clearly across technical and non-technical audiences
* Curious and proactive learner who stays current with the AI/GenAI landscape
* Entrepreneurial energy with a bias for action, experimentation, and pragmatic problem-solving

Languages

* Required: Professional proficiency in English

Education

* Required: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field
* Preferred: Master’s degree in computer science, AI, Data Science, or related field

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity, and a model of social responsibility. We are a Glassdoor Best Place to Work, and we have maintained a spot in the top four since its founding in 2009. We believe that diversity, inclusion, and collaboration are key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities, and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally.

title: Staff AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
description:
### **Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.**

At Nextiva, we're reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it's through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you're ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

**Location:** While this role is open to remote candidates across India, team members located near our Bengaluru office (Wilshire III by MFAR, 492, Hobli, RHB Colony, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048) are expected to work onsite four days per week, with the potential to increase to five days per week to support collaboration, speed, and execution.

Nextiva is looking for a **Staff AI Engineer** to help build an internal AI platform that will shape how we work across engineering and the broader organization.

This is a **Staff-level, hands-on individual contributor role** at the intersection of backend/platform engineering, system architecture, AI, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity. You'll design and build production-grade agentic workflows across the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and intelligent automation that improves engineering and business processes across Nextiva.

Working across Nextiva's technology platform, you'll identify high-value opportunities, architect solutions, and take them from concept through **deployment, operationalization, security, observability, and scale**. You'll also provide technical leadership and influence across engineering teams.

We are looking for an engineer who understands that **AI is a means to a business outcome—not the outcome itself** and can turn promising capabilities into reliable systems that create measurable value.

**Top 3 Outcomes (first 12 months)**

* **Build and operationalize agentic SDLC capabilities:** Architect and deliver production-grade AI workflows that materially improve how Nextiva engineers design, build, test, review, deploy, operate, and maintain software, with measurable improvements in engineering effectiveness.

* **Establish a scalable internal AI platform:** Develop reusable architecture, services, infrastructure, patterns, and guardrails that enable AI-powered workflows to move reliably from experimentation into secure, observable, production-scale operation.

* **Deliver measurable business impact through AI and automation:** Identify and execute high-value automation opportunities across engineering and business processes, establishing clear success metrics and demonstrating tangible improvements in productivity, quality, velocity, cost, or customer outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, build, deploy, and operate **production-grade AI systems and agentic workflows** across the SDLC and broader business processes.
* Design scalable internal platform capabilities that enable teams across Nextiva to safely and efficiently adopt AI-powered automation.
* Own solutions end-to-end—from problem definition and architecture through implementation, deployment, observability, security, scaling, and ongoing operation.
* Build robust integrations between AI models, agents, developer tooling, internal platforms, enterprise systems, APIs, data sources, and engineering workflows.
* Apply strong software engineering principles to AI systems, including modular architecture, testing, reliability, performance, maintainability, and fault tolerance.
* Design approaches for AI evaluation, observability, quality measurement, failure handling, and continuous improvement in production.
* Make pragmatic architectural and technology decisions based on **business outcomes, engineering constraints, risk, and total cost of ownership** rather than technology trends.
* Work deeply within **GCP and/or AWS**, designing cloud-native architectures and infrastructure capable of supporting secure, reliable, scalable production workloads.
* Partner with infrastructure, DevOps, security, architecture, and engineering teams to establish reusable engineering patterns, technical standards, and operational guardrails for AI-powered systems.
* Understand complex software systems and large codebases to identify opportunities where AI can improve developer workflows across the end-to-end SDLC.
* Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, agent architectures, and developer technologies to determine where they can create meaningful value for Nextiva.
* Provide **Staff-level technical leadership** through architecture reviews, design decisions, technical mentorship, and influence across engineering teams.
* Translate ambiguous business and engineering problems into clear technical strategies and executable solutions, measuring and optimizing impact based on production data, user feedback, and business results.

**Requirements**

**Must-have**

* **10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating complex production-scale systems.**
* Demonstrable hands-on experience designing and building **AI/ML or generative AI solutions that have reached production and/or delivered measurable business outcomes.**
* Strong software architecture and system design skills, including experience making consequential technical decisions for distributed or large-scale systems.
* Strong programming and software engineering fundamentals in one or more production languages such as **Java, Python, Go, or equivalent.**
* Hands-on experience working with **LLMs, generative AI, AI agents, or AI-enabled application architectures**, beyond simply consuming AI productivity tools.
* Experience taking AI solutions beyond prototypes into **deployment, operationalization, monitoring, security, reliability, and scale**.
* Deep hands-on experience with **GCP and/or AWS**, including designing and operating cloud-native production systems—not solely familiarity with cloud services or consoles.
* Strong understanding of **DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, reliability, and production operations**.
* Strong understanding of application, infrastructure, data, and AI security considerations and the ability to incorporate appropriate controls into system architecture.
* Strong understanding of the **end-to-end software development lifecycle**, developer workflows, and the challenges of working within large software systems and codebases.
* Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and select technologies based on the problem, desired business outcome, operational requirements, and long-term maintainability.
* Strong technical judgment and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, cross-functional problem spaces.
* Ability to influence technical direction across teams without relying solely on organizational authority.

**Preferred**

* Experience designing or implementing **agentic AI systems**, multi-step AI workflows, tool-using agents, or autonomous/semi-autonomous engineering workflows.
* Experience applying AI to developer productivity, software engineering, code generation, testing, code review, incident management, or other stages of the SDLC.
* Experience building **internal developer platforms, engineering productivity platforms, or enterprise automation capabilities**.
* Experience with AI evaluation frameworks, model/agent observability, prompt and context management, retrieval architectures, and production AI quality measurement.
* Experience spanning **traditional software engineering and AI engineering**—for example, a strong backend, platform, or distributed-systems engineering foundation combined with substantial hands-on AI engineering experience.
* Experience driving technical initiatives that span multiple teams, systems, or organizational domains.

**Tools & Tech Stack**

The exact stack will evolve as we select technologies based on the problems and outcomes we are solving. Relevant experience may include:

* **Cloud:** GCP and/or AWS
* **Languages:** Java, Python, Go, and/or equivalent production engineering languages
* **AI:** LLMs, generative AI, agentic frameworks and architectures, model APIs, evaluation and observability tooling
* **Platform & Infrastructure:** Containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, cloud-native services
* **Engineering:** APIs, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, observability and developer tooling
* **Security:** Cloud security, identity and access management, secrets management, secure application and AI architecture

**Nextiva DNA** (Core Competencies)

Nextiva's most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:

* **Drives Results**: Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and **simplicity** to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.
* **Critical Thinker:** Data-driven, **forward-thinking** individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work.
* **Right Attitude:** Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and **care** for customers and teammates.

Job Description — Solution Engineer (aka STS), CCaaS & Voice AI (Individual Contributor)

Company: Tata Communications

Function: Solution Engineering (aka STS) — Customer Interaction Suite

Role Type: Individual Contributor (IC) — no people management

Location: Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, or Gurugram (hybrid; on-site as per project needs)

Experience: 6–9 years in contact centre / cloud telephony / voice AI solution engineering

Travel: Up to 30% (client sites within India and occasional overseas)

About the Role (a note from the hiring head)

Tata Communications is one of the world’s most interconnected digital infrastructure companies, built on our Digital Fabric that connects networks, cloud, and customer interactions for global enterprises. Within our customer experience portfolio, we sell and deliver cloud contact centre (CCaaS) and AI-driven engagement solutions end to end — including our InstaCC™ contact centre platform, the Smartflo CCaaS platform, and the Kaleyra CCaaS/CPaaS suite we acquired in 2023 (messaging, voice, video and chat APIs), alongside a global OEM ecosystem spanning Genesys Cloud CX, Amazon Connect, Webex Contact Centre, NICE CXone

Every enterprise deal we win now hinges on two things: a well-architected CCaaS solution and a compelling Voice AI story — voice bots, IVR transformation, speech-enabled self-service, and agent-assist. I am looking for a hands-on Solution Engineer who lives in that intersection: someone who can take a customer’s call-flow diagram and turn it into a winning, priced, demonstrable solution.

Key Responsibilities

Pre-sales and Solution Design

* Own the technical win in the sales cycle: conduct discovery workshops with enterprise customers, document their current contact centre estate (telephony, routing, IVR, CRM, WFM, analytics), and translate business requirements into a target-state CCaaS + Voice AI architecture.

* Design end-to-end solutions across our portfolio — InstaCC, Smartflo, and Kaleyra CCaaS/CPaaS — and across OEM platforms (Genesys Cloud CX, Amazon Connect, Webex Contact Centre, NICE CXone, Five9), including telephony integration (SIP trunking, WebRTC, SBCs), channel routing (voice, chat, WhatsApp, email), and CRM/helpdesk integration.

* Architect the Voice AI components specifically: conversational IVR and voice bots, ASR/STT and TTS selection, NLU and LLM-driven dialogue design, barge-in, DTMF fallbacks, latency and WER budgets, and clear escalation to human agents.

Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept

* Build and maintain compelling demos that showcase CCaaS workflows and Voice AI behaviours (voice bot conversations, sentiment detection, agent-assist) that our sales teams can take into customer rooms.

* Scope, build, and run PoCs with customers; define success criteria (containment, deflection, CSAT impact) and deliver crisp readouts.

RFPs, RFIs and Commercial Support

* Lead the technical portions of RFPs/RFIs and solution defence presentations; write the technical response, solution narrative, and architecture diagrams.

* Support commercials: build bill-of-materials, platform sizing, voice/AI consumption estimates, and effort/cost inputs for SOW and pricing decisions — while keeping the solution technically honest.

Partner and Ecosystem Engagement

* Work closely with our platform partners (Genesys, Amazon, Webex, and others) on roadmap access, licensing nuances, and joint solutioning for large deals.

* Validate third-party and our own AI component choices (speech engines, LLM-based voice agents, analytics) against real customer use cases.

Implementation Handoff and Feedback

* Hand over won deals to delivery/implementation teams with clean solution documentation; join the first design reviews to ensure what was sold is what gets built.

* Feed market learnings — what wins, what doesn’t, what customers ask for — back into our product and portfolio teams.

Must-Have (Non-Negotiable)

1. CCaaS depth — 6+ years designing, demonstrating, or deploying contact centre solutions on at least one leading platform (Genesys Cloud/CX, Amazon Connect, NICE CXone, Five9, Avaya, Webex CC) and a working command of cloud telephony: SIP, PRI/trunking, WebRTC, SBCs, DTMF, call recording, and omni-channel routing.

2. Voice AI expertise — Demonstrable experience designing and delivering voice AI / conversational AI solutions: IVR and voice-bot design, ASR/STT and TTS engines (e.g., Azure Speech, Google STT, Amazon Transcribe/Polly), NLU and/or LLM-driven dialogue flows, barge-in and error handling, and real-world tuning for accuracy (WER), latency, and containment.

3. Solution engineering craft — Proven track record in pre-sales: discovery, solution architecture, demos, PoCs, RFP/RFI responses, BoM and pricing support.

4. India market context — Understanding of India’s telecom/enterprise landscape relevant to voice workloads: carrier numbering and provisioning practices, TRAI/DoT compliance considerations, and how enterprise contact centres buy telephony in India.

5. Communication — Ability to explain architecture to CIOs and call flows to operations heads; comfortable presenting and debating in customer rooms; excellent written technical documentation.

Good to Have

* Exposure to CPaaS APIs (messaging, voice, WhatsApp) — experience with Kaleyra or similar is a plus.

* CRM and ecosystem integration knowledge (Salesforce, MS Dynamics, helpdesk platforms).

* Working knowledge of speech analytics, sentiment analysis, real-time agent-assist, and LLM-based voice agents.

* Relevant certifications (Genesys, AWS Connect, Google/cloud speech services, etc.).

title: Lead Engineer - Passkeys
description:
Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that "we are all in this together" – we continue to offer a full\-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise\-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog.



As a Lead Engineer for our Passkeys team, you will be responsible for leading the technical direction and supporting the engineering effort of a team focused on building and maintaining Bitwarden's WebAuthn credential provider implementation across browser, desktop, and mobile. The Passkeys team owns our implementation of WebAuthn and FIDO2 \- creating and asserting credentials, integrating with each platform's credential provider APIs, and the emerging standards for moving credentials between providers so that users are never locked in.



You will be expected to own and understand the entirety of the team's domain, and be able to support the other engineers on the team as well as engage in well\-reasoned discussions with other technical leaders in the organization.


**WHAT YOU WILL DO**


* Design, build, and maintain Bitwarden's implementation of the WebAuthn and FIDO2 standards in Rust, including credential creation, assertion, and storage within an end\-to\-end encrypted vault
* Integrate our passkey implementation with each platform's credential provider surface across browser, desktop, and mobile clients
* Participate in the hands\-on design, development, and evolution of the shared Rust SDK, including language bindings and FFI, consumed across all Bitwarden clients
* Implement and help shape emerging standards for credential portability and secure import and export between providers
* Build the interoperability testing that keeps our implementation correct against the long tail of relying parties, browsers, and platforms our users encounter in the real world
* Work closely with your manager to maintain the technical roadmap for the team, ensuring that core platform dependencies are up to date and emerging technologies are considered for potential adoption.
* Unblock and support other engineers on the team.
* Collaborate with other Tech Leads to ensure that cross\-team technical direction is aligned when initiatives span team boundaries.
* Serve as a representative of the team in technical discussions and be able to speak authoritatively about your domain.
* Set the example for thorough code reviews, using them to spread knowledge on the team and ensure high standards for code quality.
* Occasionally review \& approve bug fixes submitted by the user community


**WHAT YOU BRING**


* 8\+ years of experience as lead or team lead. Experience designing and implementing complex user interaction flows in Angular applications and native OS (Windows, MacOS, Linux), including developing against native OS APIs.
* Expertise in developing and maintaining production Rust components, including the design and application of libraries, language bindings, and FFI.
* Experience implementing a standard or protocol from its specification, and the discipline that requires \- reading the spec closely, handling the edge cases, and testing against real\-world implementations rather than assuming conformance.
* Working knowledge of applied cryptography \- you can reason about public key cryptography, signatures, and key handling, and you know where the sharp edges are
* A rigorous approach to correctness \- you write readable, testable code, and you think carefully about failure modes in software that handles sensitive data.
* A bias for long\-horizon thinking, ensuring that decisions made today build stable and maintainable tooling for the future.
* Experience on a Platform team, where other teams are your customers, and you are responsible for ensuring that their feature development can be done with tooling as a support and not a hindrance.
* Experience using AI tooling in your development and testing workflow (Anthropic Claude preferred)
* Collaborative and adaptable mindset
* Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills
* Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution

### **Why Join Us**



This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations.



Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization \& contribute to products used by customers around the world.



If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast\-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.

We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.

**The Role**


We're looking for a **Research Engineer, AI** to build the models and systems that make visa processing faster, more accurate and more reliable than ever before.


You'll take ideas from research to production, testing new approaches across LLMs, agents and document intelligence, and shipping the ones that move real outcomes like approval rates, turnaround times and cost per application.


This role is for someone with a strong engineering foundation who loves going deep on hard AI problems, and who gets as much satisfaction from a system that works in production as from a clever idea.

**The Job**

* **Build AI systems that do real work** by designing and shipping LLM\-powered agents that reliably complete complex, multi\-step tasks across external tools, APIs and web interfaces.
* **Push the frontier of document intelligence** by building pipelines that extract, verify and reason over information from unstructured documents and images with high accuracy at scale.
* **Define how we measure AI quality** by building evaluation frameworks, benchmarks and datasets that show how accurate, reliable and safe our models are across the long tail of real\-world cases, before and after they ship.
* **Run experiments that change decisions** by comparing models, prompting strategies, fine\-tuning approaches and routing logic to improve accuracy while reducing latency and cost.
* **Own systems end to end** by taking work from prototype to production, including data pipelines, inference infrastructure, monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop fallbacks for when models aren’t confident.

You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 3\-6 years of software engineering experience, including meaningful work building and shipping ML or LLM\-based systems in production.
* Are exceptionally strong in Python and comfortable with the modern AI stack, such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, LLM APIs, vector databases and agent frameworks.

* Have exposure to document AI, OCR, large\-scale data pipelines, or making inference fast and cost\-efficient at scale.

Atlys is changing that.


We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.

**The Role**


We're looking for a **Research Scientist, AI** to invent the methods that make our AI systems more accurate, more reliable and more autonomous than anything available off the shelf.


You'll work on the hardest open problems in our stack: agents that act reliably across unfamiliar government portals, models that reason over messy real\-world documents, and systems that know when they don't know. You'll set the research direction, run careful experiments and partner with our Research Engineers to turn breakthroughs into production gains in approval rates, turnaround times and cost per application.


This role is for someone with deep research expertise who is energised by problems that don't have a paper to copy yet, and who measures success by real\-world impact, not just benchmark scores.

**The Job**

* **Set and drive a research agenda on open problems in agentic AI**, including how LLM\-powered agents plan, use tools, take actions and recover from errors over long, multi\-step tasks.
* **Develop new methods for multimodal understanding and reasoning**, so models can reliably extract, verify and reason over noisy, unstructured real\-world inputs across formats and languages.
* **Design and run post\-training research**, including fine\-tuning, preference optimisation and reinforcement learning, to push model capabilities beyond what general\-purpose frontier models offer.
* **Research calibration, uncertainty estimation and self\-verification** so AI systems know when to act autonomously and when to defer to a human.
* **Build evaluations, benchmarks and synthetic data methods** that give an honest picture of model quality, robustness and failure modes, especially on the long tail.
* **Collaborate closely with research engineers** to take ideas from prototype to production, and share findings through internal write\-ups and, where appropriate, publications.

**The Ideal Candidate**


You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have a PhD or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related field, or equivalent research experience, plus 3\+ years of applied or academic research in ML, NLP or computer vision.
* Have a track record of original research, such as publications at top venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, CVPR), influential open\-source work, or research that clearly moved production metrics.
* Have deep hands\-on experience with LLMs beyond prompting, including fine\-tuning, RLHF/DPO or other post\-training methods, evaluation design, and a strong grasp of why models succeed or fail.
* Are strong in Python and PyTorch, and can run experiments yourself, from data curation and training runs to careful analysis.
* Bring rigour with a bias to impact: you ask sharp questions, design clean experiments, avoid fooling yourself, and care about whether the result changes what we build.

**What you can expect**


Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

**Here's what you can expect:**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment, software and compute for your research.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.
